title: Efficient probabilistic weather forecasting at quarter-degree resolution with two-sided transport attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.35545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-resolution probabilistic weather forecasting remains computationally demanding. Here we present Astra, a 0.25$^\circ$ ensemble model trained on eight H200 GPUs. It combines Kantorovich Attention, a two-sided transport attention in which each region chooses where it reads from and writes to, so every region sends and receives at token resolution, with a self-featurised continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) that also scores forecasts in the model's multiscale features. In WeatherBench 2, Astra matches GenCast's CRPS averaged over five upper-air targets and days 1-10 with 9.8% of its hardware-normalised training compute. Verified against ERA5, its CRPS and ensemble-mean root-mean-square error are lower than the ECMWF ensemble's on all 600 variable, level and lead-time combinations, and its CRPS is lower than GenCast's on 73.5% of them. A 15-day member needs 39 times fewer floating-point operations than GenCast's GPU implementation

translated_title: 采用双向传输注意力机制实现四分之一度分辨率的高效概率天气预报
translated_abstract: 高分辨率概率天气预报仍然计算成本高昂。我们在此提出Astra，一个在八块H200 GPU上训练的0.25°集合预报模型。它结合了两项关键技术：一是Kantorovich注意力——一种双向传输注意力机制，其中每个区域自行选择从何处读取、向何处写入信息，从而使每个区域都能以token分辨率进行信息的发送与接收；二是一种自特征化的连续排序概率评分（CRPS），它还能在模型的多尺度特征中对预报进行评分。在WeatherBench 2上，Astra在五个高空目标及第1-10天的平均CRPS上与GenCast相当，但仅使用了其硬件归一化训练算力的9.8%。经ERA5验证，其CRPS和集合平均均方根误差在全部600个变量、层次与预报时效组合上均低于ECMWF集合预报，且其CRPS在73.5%的组合上低于GenCast。一个15天预报成员所需的浮点运算量仅为GenCast GPU实现的1/39。
tldr: 提出Astra模型，通过双向传输注意力（Kantorovich Attention）与自特征化CRPS损失相结合，仅用约10%的训练算力即实现0.25°分辨率概率预报，在全部指标组合上超越ECMWF集合预报，且计算量降低39倍。
en_tdlr: Astra combines Kantorovich Attention (two-sided transport attention) with a self-featurised CRPS loss to achieve efficient quarter-degree probabilistic weather forecasting, matching GenCast with only 9.8% of its training compute, outperforming the ECMWF ensemble on all 600 metric combinations, and requiring 39× fewer FLOPs per 15-day forecast.
